name: Quick Reaction Boots
body:
Aura weak abjuration; CL 5th; Slot feet; Price 2,000 gp; Weight 2 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

These thin, light boots sometimes seem to have a mind of their own, silently moving their wearer out of the way of trouble just in the nick of time.

The wearer of these supple leather boots gains a +5 insight bonus to the first initiative check he has to make each day.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells anticipate peril; Cost 1,000 gp
